mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior month compresses discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days when the rate falls by at least 0.1 percentage points.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is negative in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.1 percentage points over the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 5.0%, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward return is positive in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) by more than 0.5% from the prior month indicate strengthening consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both > 0.5% increase from prior month
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is negative in more than 50% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS increase by more than 0.5% from the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: When CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.5% annualized, it signals a high-inflation regime that triggers aggressive monetary tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward return is positive in more than 50% of instances where CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.5% annualized.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly expansion in real GDP (GDPC1) by at least 0.5% indicates sustained economic growth that supports corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward return is negative in more than 50% of instances where GDPC1 grows by at least 0.5% quarter-over-quarter.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100 (index 2017=100), it indicates manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate revenue growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward return is positive in more than 50% of instances where INDPRO falls below 100.

mechanism_narrative: When non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 0.5% and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.1 percentage points from the prior month, it signals a strengthening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS > 0.5% increase and UNRATE < 0.1pp decrease from prior month
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is negative in more than 50% of instances where PAYEMS increases by more than 0.5% and UNRATE decreases by more than 0.1 percentage points from the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 4.0% and CPIAUCSL > 3.0% annualized), aggressive interest rate hikes to combat inflation suppress equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is positive in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.0% and CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.0% annualized.
